clean_subset.definition: decisions where all three cards are 30-27 (or 50-45) for the winner, so every round's winner is known

em_all_cards.definition: all decision cards whose total implies only 10-9 rounds; latent round winners per judge, EM with a weighted no-intercept logistic M-step

holdout.note: judges treated as independent given round stats; 10-8s ignored; baseline = fighter with more sig strikes landed (ties count half)

form.note: full rounds only, fighter-fights with >= 2 full rounds; two-way fixed effects (fighter output, opponent allowance) on log mean per-round count; fighters and opponents with >= 4 such fights. resid_sd_log is the calibration target for between-fight spread; implied_form_sd removes the sampling noise implied by round-to-round variance inside the fight. It still holds style-matchup interaction, so it is an upper bound on pure night-to-night form.
